exposure: Time of sFGR onset (Early <32 weeks vs Late >32 weeks)
Selective fetal growth restriction (sFGR) diagnosis (Delphi consensus vs ISUOG criteria)
cohort: 1053 dichorionic twins seen from the first trimester.
finding: Dichorionic twins with selective fetal growth restriction (sFGR) have worse perinatal outcomes, with early onset being more prevalent.
